en.title: Resident Evil Star Austin Abrams' Charming Netflix Christmas Rom-Com
en.summary: Before battling zombies, Austin Abrams charmed audiences in a heartwarming Netflix holiday series. Discover the hidden gem that showcases a different side of the popular actor.
en.body:
While many fans know **Austin Abrams** for his recent, intense role in **Resident Evil**, his acting resume boasts a delightful surprise for those seeking a cozier watch. Abrams starred as the titular Dash in Netflix's charming holiday romance series, **Dash & Lily**. This gem, which premiered in 2020, offers a refreshing contrast to the survival horror genre, showcasing Abrams' ability to embody a character on a journey of emotional discovery.

Set against the vibrant, snow-dusted backdrop of New York City during Christmas, **Dash & Lily** follows two teenagers who connect through a red notebook filled with dares and dreams left around iconic city landmarks. Abrams plays Dash, a cynical but secretly romantic teen who finds his world turned upside down by the optimistic and adventurous Lily. Their evolving connection, facilitated by the mysterious notebook, forms the heart of this feel-good series. The show was praised for its genuine chemistry between the leads and its affectionate portrayal of the city during the holiday season, making it a perfect binge for anyone who loves a good rom-com with a dash of festive spirit.

## A Tale of Two Teens and a Notebook

**Dash & Lily** wasn't just another Christmas special; it was a full-fledged romantic comedy series that managed to capture the magic of a holiday romance without feeling overly saccharine. The narrative arc for Dash, in particular, is one of transformation. Initially weighed down by the holiday blues and a sense of disillusionment, his interactions with Lily, played by Midori Francis, gradually pull him out of his shell. The show expertly navigates their developing relationship, from hesitant exchanges in the notebook to tentative real-life encounters. The season finale, while concluding their immediate story, left fans hoping for more adventures in the city.

## Why Fans Fell for Dash & Lily

Despite its charming premise and a strong performance from Abrams, **Dash & Lily** only received one season on Netflix. While the show's cancellation was a disappointment for its growing fanbase, the Season 1 finale was crafted to feel satisfying on its own. Many viewers appreciated the show's hopeful tone and its unique approach to a holiday romance, especially as it provided a lighter, more character-driven project for an actor who has since taken on more demanding roles. For fans of **Resident Evil** or Abrams' other dramatic turns, revisiting **Dash & Lily** offers a wonderful opportunity to see a different facet of his talent, proving his range extends far beyond the survival horror genre.

## What's Next

While **Dash & Lily** may not be returning for a second season, **Austin Abrams** continues to be a busy actor with roles in projects like **Resident Evil** and films such as **Whalefall**. Fans looking for more of his work can stream **Dash & Lily** now on Netflix, and keep an eye on his upcoming filmography for future projects.
